subject: sf-rz
title: SF.RZ.------EXP.INFO.B.
description: Chart 2 of 2 on book p. 448 (TRF(CW)-20). SF-RZ (self-realization) is the subject; EXP-INFO-B (expansion information basis) is the partner. From the subject: TR (transformation), AF-DY (affinity dynamics) and PART (participation). From TR: PRI-INFO (principle information). From PRI-INFO: EXB-H-OR (establishing high order). From AF-DY: VT-DY (vibrational dynamics). From PART: RT-DY (reality dynamics). From RT-DY: OP-SD (option spread). From OP-SD: SOC-RT-P (social reality particulars).
